department: Lee Kong Chian School of Medicine (LKCMedicine)

deadline.value: LKCMedicine August 2027 intake application window closes December 31, 2026 (one month earlier than NTU's central Jan 31 deadline; January 2028 intake: June 1–30, 2027).

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for biomedical sciences.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: All LKCMedicine PhD applicants must obtain agreement from at least one eligible PhD supervisor before applying and attach confirmation email correspondence.
supervisor.quote: Please note that all applicants must obtain the agreement of at least one eligible PhD supervisor before submitting an application.

also.quote: 5 Proof of Agreement for PhD Supervision | You are required to attach the email correspondence confirming the proposed supervisor’s agreement from at least 1 proposed supervisor.

funding.value: Some PhD projects and central NTU scholarships (RSS/NPGS/PGA) provide competitive funding; self-financed applicants must submit bank statement proof of financial support.
funding.quote: A range of research projects is available across LKCMedicine's research areas, with some projects may offer scholarship opportunities.

also.quote: 11 Documentary Proof of Financial Support | Applicants who wish to opt for self-financed must submit documentary evidence of their ability to support their study in the form of bank statement.
The NTU Research Scholarship is awarded to outstanding graduate students for research. | In addition to the monthly stipend, the award also covers the annual tuition fee.

entry_route.value: Direct PhD entry from a strong bachelor's degree with minimum Honours (Distinction) or equivalent (master's certificate/transcript submitted only if applicable).
entry_route.quote: Bachelor’s Degree: A strong Bachelor’s degree with minimum Honours (Distinction) and its equivalent.

also.quote: 3 Bachelor’s degree certificate | Master’s degree certificate (if applicable)

gre_general.value: LKCMedicine checklist states a GRE scoresheet is highly recommended for applicants who are not graduates of autonomous universities in Singapore.
gre_general.quote: 7 GRE scoresheet | Highly recommended for applicants who are not graduates from autonomous universities in Singapore.

english_waiver.value: TOEFL/IELTS is compulsory unless the applicant's university medium of instruction was fully in English, verified by an official proof letter from the university.
english_waiver.quote: Compulsory for applicants whose medium of instruction is not English. | If your university's medium of instruction was fully in English, please contact your university to request a proof letter and us the letter confirming your medium of instruction.

notes: LKCMedicine PhD minimum full-time candidature is 3 years (maximum 5 years), requires confirmed supervisor agreement email at application, and closes December 31, 2026 for August 2027 entry.
